findings.location: translation.html，与教会的关系，第4段末句
findings.source_quote: It is far better to move on and find a church that you can support than to stay in a church and be in a state of constant opposition.
findings.suggested_fix: 与其留在一间教会里，却一直持反对态度，不如离开，寻找一间你能够支持的教会。
findings.translation_quote: 与其留在一间不断反对的教会里，不如离开，寻找一间你能够支持的教会。
